title: Feature Request: Calibration algorithms and the Wear OS complication
body:
I'm using the LibreOOPAlgorithm (https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm) with XDrip+, but it seems to break the Wear OS XDrip complication - it just displays 'null null ()', as I've shown in the photo below, with the algorithm turned on, though if I add a manual calibration to the phone app it shows up fine on the complication, like a normal glucose level reading. The XDrip watch face displays readings fine, but I really want to use my own watch face. Please could you make calibration algorithms like LibreOOPAlgorithm work with the Wear OS Xdrip+ complication? I'm using a Ticwatch E2 with a Pixel 2 XL running XDrip version d60b2be-2019.02.22 (my watch is also running this version).

![img_20190222_203256](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24255732/53269997-49ca1500-36e2-11e9-9a39-6b01dd005a86.jpg)
